library_preparation_preflight.summary: micronaut-retry exposes a plain-Java SimpleRetry/DefaultRetryPredicate API usable without DI, Docker, or extra env setup, matching the no-extra-setup pattern already used by sibling io.micronaut test modules (http-client, cache-caffeine, security) in this repo.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: Favor testing the library's plain-Java surface — io.micronaut.retry.simple.SimpleRetry, io.micronaut.retry.annotation.DefaultRetryPredicate, io.micronaut.retry.exception.CircuitOpenException — driven directly without an ApplicationContext, rather than wiring up @Retryable/@CircuitBreaker on DI-managed beans, which would need micronaut-inject-java as an annotation processor and @MicronautTest. This mirrors how micronaut-http-client's test calls HttpClient.create() directly instead of going through DI.
risks: If the generated test instead tries to exercise @Retryable/@CircuitBreaker via annotation-processed beans, it will silently no-op without an annotationProcessor dependency on micronaut-inject-java — compilation succeeds but retry logic never triggers at runtime, so this should be caught in local Gradle/Native Image verification if attempted.
